title: Taking a guest out of the call is a durable obligation the room can see
why: Declining or blocking a guest who was let in used to call LiveKit once and ignore the answer: a failed removal looked like success, and the guest stayed in the call until they left or their token expired. S1-05A §7 requires the removal to be retried and reconciled with a visible pending state, never treated as done because a helper returned, and never left to token expiry.

Migration 0014 records the removal in the same transaction as the decision. It settles only on evidence (removed, or verifiably absent); a failure stays pending and the worker retries it with backoff. After settling it keeps watch while an earlier token could still bring the guest back.

LobbyEntry gains an optional removal: its state (pending, removed, absent), how many times it was tried, and the last error. Members see it in the snapshot and in the decision's reply; a guest's own replies do not carry it.
